rubric: A settings page that shows a secret key in full: credential.

criteria.exposure: a password, an API key, a token or a connection string shown in full

reading.why: A secret key shown in full beside Copy and Revoke is a credential.

ruledOut.question: exposure
ruledOut.label: none
ruledOut.why: A secret key is shown in full. It is not: nothing sensitive: ordinary interface text, and synthetic or placeholder data (names like Jane Doe, addresses at example.com, obviously fake numbers).

ruledOut.question: exposure
ruledOut.label: personal_data
ruledOut.why: A secret key is shown in full. It is not: a real person's name together with contact, address, identity or payment details; synthetic or placeholder data is none.
